surface_mechanism_description: Ligand exchange between TMA and surface hydroxyl groups followed by water pulse to regenerate OH sites.
evidence: The loss of Al /H20849hfac/H20850/H11569 species versus TMA exposure can be explained by ligand exchange between TMA and the Al/H20849hfac/H20850/H11569 species. The TMA may displace the Al /H20849hfac/H20850/H11569 species by the reaction: 3Al/H20849hfac/H20850/H11569 + Al/H20849CH3/H208503 → Al/H20849hfac/H208503 + 3AlCH3/H11569, where the asterisks designate the surface species.
